description: Communauté d'Agglomération Ventoux Comtat Venaissin: transport datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté d'Agglomération Ventoux Comtat Venaissin. Coverage: Communauté d'Agglomération Ventoux Comtat Venaissin. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about transport; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Stationnements cyclables de la Communauté d’agglomération Ventoux-Comt; Arrêts de bus Trans'CoVe de la Communauté d'agglomération Ventoux Comt; Réseau de transport Trans'CoVe de la Communauté d'agglomération Ventou. Formats seen: GEOJSON, OGC:WFS, GTFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
